doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

title: Son Godet and Son Miller
summary: Burns mentions Son Godet, who played piano and trumpet, and Miller's early blues.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Where the blues came from: Handy, Bolden and early blues

blocks.x: Yeah, six, seven years. Because he's playing when I couldn't play, you know. I wasn't big enough.
Did you get, uh, I gave you, uh, uh, uh, Son Godet, didn't I? Yeah. Yeah. I gave you, uh, did you take, uh, uh, Hunter? Hunter? No. His brother, Godet.
That was a very good musician.
What did he play? He played piano and trumpet.
Oh, yeah. Mm-hmm. And talking about, uh, this, Son Miller.
Yeah. And, uh, did he die, or?
